limiter_probe.meaning: Successful measurement; asserted delay acceptance is in dynamics_processing_test

verification_order: Full stable/legacy suite ran the completed production implementation and allocation-failure harness.
ASan and TSan subsequently ran added processor-reset heap guards against that implementation.
Final normal integration ran the same implementation after formatting to repository indentation, plus an explicit same-delay history assertion and a manager-reset heap guard.
Final make built the application after those formatting/test changes. No production semantic edits followed the sanitizer runs.
limits: Limiter is linked sample-peak processing, not true peak or oversampling.
Lookahead and latency-bearing topology changes explicitly clear FX/compensation history and can interrupt audio; seamless delay modulation is not claimed.
Compensation covers the existing parallel tracks into the master chain. No external sidechain/send-return routing was added.
Diagnostics report latest worker DSP delay separately from queue timing; callback/project clocks are not hardware-audible positions or per-buffer historical latency.
Exact-range bounce trims common delay; existing normalization remains and general tail/export isolation work remains separate.
Ordinary compressor retains independent channel detection; sidechain-capable compressor retains its existing linked left-input fallback and signed-average explicit key.
Applied reduction is the minimum gain in the most recent block before makeup; other effects retain explicitly labeled RMS delta.
Heap instrumentation covers production limiter, both compressors, and manager objects in guarded paths; it is not a certification of every other effect setter.
No manual listening, visual acceptance, physical device calibration, commit, install, or release.
